learning_outcomes.text: Explains the basic structures and safe working principles of machine tools.
Explains the cutting tool systems and tool-work referencing processes used in CNC lathes and CNC milling machines.
Knows the program codes used in CNC machines and their meanings, and performs control panel operations.
Write programs using cycles and subroutines.
Students process workpieces using the programs they wrote on CNC lathes and CNC milling machines.

syllabus_topics: Historical development of machine tools and CNC machines, their parts, safe working rules
Cutting tool technology, tool selection, attachment and removal of cutters to CNC machines.
Parts and features of CNC lathe and mill
Tool and part resetting on CNC Lathe and CNC Milling machines
Absolute, incremental and polar programming principles in CNC lathe
Cycles used in CNC lathe (G70, G71, G72) and applications
Cycles used in CNC lathe (G73, G74, G75, G76) and applications
Absolute, incremental and polar programming principles in CNC milling
Cycles used in CNC milling machines (G80, G81, G82, G83) and their applications
Cycles used in CNC milling machines (G84, G85, G86, G87, G88, G89) and their applications
Sub programming technique, programming using subprograms
Machining the part using single and multiple repetitive cycles
